cards.ex: I don't know how you put up with his constant complaining.
cards.exUz: Men uning doimiy shikoyatlariga qanday chidashingizni bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir yoki kimdirdan norozi bo'lsangiz ham sabr qilib bardosh berish.

cards.ex: I'm really looking forward to seeing you next week.
cards.exUz: Sizni keyingi hafta ko'rishni chin dildan kutyapman.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda bo'ladigan hodisani xursandchilik bilan kutish, umid qilish.

cards.ex: We've run out of milk, so I need to go to the store.
cards.exUz: Sutimiz tugadi, shuning uchun do'konga borishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning zaxirasi tugab qolishi, yetishmasligi.

cards.ex: I need to catch up with the latest news.
cards.exUz: Men so'nggi yangiliklardan xabardor bo'lishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan muddatga, tezlikka yoki bilim darajasiga yetib olish.

cards.ex: He cheated on the test, but he got away with it.
cards.exUz: U testda aldadi, lekin jazolanmasdan qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror noto'g'ri ish qilib, jazodan qutilib qolish.

cards.ex: I think I'm coming down with a cold.
cards.exUz: O'ylashimcha, shamollayapman.
cards.uzDef: Kasal bo'lib qolish, odatda oddiy kasalliklar (gripp, shamollash).

cards.ex: I get along with my neighbors really well.
cards.exUz: Qo'shnilarim bilan juda yaxshi kelishaman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamlar bilan yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish, do'stona aloqada bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
cards.exUz: Men shakar iste'molini kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning miqdorini kamaytirish, qisqartirish.

cards.ex: I've always looked up to my older brother.
cards.exUz: Men har doim akamni hurmat qilganman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir hayrat bilan hurmat qilish, namuna sifatida qarash.

cards.ex: She broke up with her boyfriend last week.
cards.exUz: U o'tgan hafta yigiti bilan ajrashdi.
cards.uzDef: Romantik munosabatlarni tugatish, ajralish.

cards.ex: It's hard to keep up with all the new technology.
cards.exUz: Barcha yangi texnologiyalardan xabardor bo'lish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Tezlik, standart yoki yangiliklardan ortda qolmaslik, doimo xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: Are you going in for the marathon this year?
cards.exUz: Bu yil marafon poygasida ishtirok etasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Biror musobaqada yoki faoliyatda ishtirok etish.

cards.ex: I put his success down to hard work.
cards.exUz: Men uning muvaffaqiyatini qattiq mehnatga bog'layman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshqa narsaning sababi deb hisoblash, bog'lash.

cards.ex: I'll get back to you with an answer tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga sizga javob bilan qaytib aloqaga chiqaman.
cards.uzDef: Keyinroq biror kimsa bilan aloqaga chiqish, qo'ng'iroq qilish yoki javob berish.

cards.ex: She came up with a great idea for the project.
cards.exUz: U loyiha uchun ajoyib g'oya o'ylab topdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi g'oya, reja yoki yechimni o'ylab topish.

cards.ex: He looks down on people who didn't go to college.
cards.exUz: U kollejda o'qimagan odamlarni mensimaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir pastroq deb hisoblash, mensimaslik.

cards.ex: You should always stand up for what you believe in.
cards.exUz: Siz har doim o'zingiz ishonadigan narsani himoya qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani yoki kimnidir himoya qilish, qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: He walked out on his family.
cards.exUz: U oilasini tashlab ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir kutilmaganda va mas'uliyatsizlarcha tashlab ketish.

cards.ex: I can always fall back on my parents if I need help.
cards.exUz: Agar menga yordam kerak bo'lsa, men har doim ota-onamga ishonishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Muammo paytida biror narsaga yoki kimdirga yordam uchun murojaat qilish, ishonish.

cards.ex: I finally got around to cleaning the garage.
cards.exUz: Nihoyat garajni tozalashga vaqt topdim.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri qilinishi kerak bo'lgan ishni qilish uchun vaqt topish.

cards.ex: I had to take the shirt back to the store because it was too small.
cards.exUz: Ko'ylak juda kichik bo'lgani uchun uni do'konga qaytarishga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani sotib olingan joyga qaytarib berish.

cards.ex: They're planning to do away with the old system.
cards.exUz: Ular eski tizimni yo'q qilishni rejalashtirmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani butunlay yo'q qilish, bekor qilish.

cards.ex: You need to face up to your responsibilities.
cards.exUz: Siz o'z mas'uliyatlaringizni tan olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz haqiqatni tan olish va qabul qilish.

cards.ex: Let's get down to business.
cards.exUz: Keling, ishga kirishamiz.
cards.uzDef: Muhim yoki jiddiy ishni boshlash.

cards.ex: He didn't live up to his potential.
cards.exUz: U o'z salohiyatiga erisha olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Standart, umid yoki va'daga mos kelish, erishish.

cards.ex: I'll make up for being late.
cards.exUz: Kechikkanimni qoplayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror xato yoki yo'qotishni qoplash, to'ldirish.

cards.ex: He didn't measure up to the requirements of the job.
cards.exUz: U ish talablariga javob bermadi.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan standartga javob berish, mos kelish.

cards.ex: He owned up to breaking the window.
cards.exUz: U oynani sindirganini tan oldi.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki noto'g'ri ishni tan olish.

cards.ex: He accused the politician of selling out to big business.
cards.exUz: U siyosatchini yirik biznesga sotilganlikda aybladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z prinsip va e'tiqodlaridan pul yoki hokimiyat uchun voz kechish.

cards.ex: You need to stand up to bullies.
cards.exUz: Siz zo'ravonlarga qarshi turishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir yoki nimadirga qarshi jasorat bilan turish.
